card.name: Antibiotic label text before key terms
card.fires_on: Marked positions inside antibacterial labels: partway through drug names like piperacillin or avibactam, spaces before dose numbers, and small words like of or a in 'consideration of a change in antibacterial regimen'.

modes.label: Inside antibiotic names
modes.description: Partway through an antibiotic or brand name, often in combination products.
modes.example: icated in patients with known serious hypersensitivity to the components of ZERBAXA (ceftolozane and tazobactam),<< p>>iperacillin/tazobactam

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A blank space right before an amount of drug in a dosing table or sentence.

modes.label: Words in the surgical-intervention phrase
modes.description: Small words in the sentence about surgery and changing the antibacterial regimen.
modes.example: and/or consideration<< of>> a change in antibacterial regimen may be

card.plain: It lights up in antibiotic labels at spots inside drug names, just before dose amounts, and in a stock phrase about surgery and changing therapy.
